meta.name: gtars
meta.description: Use Gtars for local genomic interval models and set algebra, overlaps and counts, consensus and coverage, tokenization, fragment processing, and refget/BEDbase planning across Python, Rust, and the CLI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析基因组区间数据并进行集合运算
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要高效处理基因组区间重叠、计数和覆盖等分析任务
copy.tagline_en: Analyze genomic interval data and perform set operations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need efficient analysis of genomic intervals including overlaps, counts, and coverage

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能直接处理基因组区间数据（如 BED 文件），完成区域重叠查找、覆盖度轨道生成、序列标记化等任务，并给出可执行的 Python 或命令行用法。
howto.when: 当用户提到 BED 文件、覆盖度轨道，或要求做重叠检测等基因组处理时触发。

say.text: 用 gtars 找出这两个 BED 文件的重叠区域
say.note: 会构建索引并返回重叠区间

say.text: 生成这个 BED 文件的 BigWig 覆盖度轨道
say.note: 调用 uniwig 生成覆盖度文件

say.text: 用 gtars 的 tokenizer 把基因组区间转成 token
say.note: 使用 TreeTokenizer 进行标记化

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can process genomic interval data (e.g., BED files), detect overlaps, create coverage tracks, and tokenize sequences, while providing runnable Python or CLI examples.
howto.when_en: When the user mentions BED files, coverage tracks, or asks for overlap detection or other genomic processing.

say_en.text: Use gtars to find overlapping regions between these two BED files.
say_en.note: Builds an index and returns overlaps.

say_en.text: Generate a BigWig coverage track from this BED file.
say_en.note: Uses uniwig to create a coverage file.

say_en.text: Use gtars' tokenizer to convert genomic intervals into tokens.
